name: wellnessé
summary: Sand-toned, film-grain wellness clinic site with all-caps tight grotesk headings, soft-focus ethereal photography and square-cornered khaki cards.

fonts.pairing: one grotesk family: medium-weight caps headings with -0.03em tracking, small caps eyebrows, capitalised grey descriptions; a book serif only for testimonial quotes

signature: fixed film-grain noise layer over the whole page
hero split into a blurred frosted half with caps headline and a sharp photo half
giant outlined-to-solid SERVICES wordmark sliding under a full-bleed portrait with glass service tiles
khaki process grid alternating huge pale numerals with photo tiles
imagery: soft-focus, low-contrast beige photography: skin, linen, dried flowers, calm women at home, blurred and desaturated
layout_grid: 1440px canvas, about 990px centred content column, generous 120px section gaps, 3-column card grids with 8 to 16px gutters
